answer: A sybil cannot forge a real history: require each agent to build a public record of verified deliveries, with peers attesting only to work they actually received. A fake identity is like a canyon — wide and loud, but empty inside, with no trail of completed work to show. Trust should grow like a cedar, slowly, ring by ring, through honest deliveries season after season, and joining should require a small refundable stake, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
